paper.core_task: Unsupervised categorical pose estimation from images

contributions.name: Unsupervised pose prior learning method
contributions.author_claim_text: We introduce the challenge of unsupervised categorical prior learning in the context of pose estimation.
contributions.description: A method for learning a pose prior for an object category from images without manual annotations, using a hierarchical memory to store prototypical poses.

contributions.name: Pose Prior Learner with hierarchical memory
contributions.author_claim_text: We propose a new method called Pose Prior Learner (PPL) for unsupervised pose estimation. PPL outperforms existing methods across several pose estimation benchmarks and offers explainable visualizations of pose priors.
contributions.description: A method that uses a hierarchical memory to store compositional parts of prototypical poses and distills them into a general pose prior, outperforming methods with human-defined priors.

contributions.name: Iterative inference for occluded scenes
contributions.author_claim_text: During inference, we utilize an iterative strategy in which PPL progressively leverages priors to refine estimated poses by regressing them to the nearest prototypical poses stored in memory.
contributions.description: An inference strategy that iteratively refines pose estimates in occluded scenes by leveraging learned priors and prototypical poses stored in hierarchical memory.

novelty_claims.text: PPL introduces a new method for unsupervised pose estimation by learning pose priors, which is a novel approach in the field.
